review_kind: Exact-source AI technical translation and self-review (Claude); existing catalog terms reused for button names; no native-speaker signoff
review: Item 707 Make Masks layout: group titles, Open File / Folder, Measure, Previous/Next tooltips, Keep and Save mask menus, Export to vvvv. Preserve literal paths, file globs and module names (Make Masks, Mask generation, Measure, Mask).

records.key: Also write every saved mask in Make Masks, and every field Mask generation and Measure process, for a vvvv gamma patch: labels, outlines, the image, one row per object and a .vl project, one folder per field. Make Masks writes beside the images in vvvv/make_masks, Mask generation in vvvv/mask and Measure in vvvv/measure. Images and masks are only read. Default off.

Make Masks writes beside the images in vvvv/make_masks, Mask generation in vvvv/mask and Measure in vvvv/measure. Images and masks are only read. Default off.
records.translation: Escribe también cada máscara guardada en Make Masks, y cada campo que procesan Mask generation y Measure, para un patch de vvvv gamma: etiquetas, contornos, la imagen, una fila por objeto y un proyecto .vl, una carpeta por campo. Make Masks escribe junto a las imágenes en vvvv/make_masks, Mask generation en vvvv/mask y Measure en vvvv/measure. Las imágenes y máscaras solo se leen. Desactivado por defecto.

records.key: No folder selected — click Open File / Folder…

records.key: Open a folder of images to curate. The arrow also opens one image file: a 2D image opens with the other images of its folder, a z-stack or volume (TIFF, OME-TIFF or MRC) opens in the Mask view to draw 3D masks slice by slice, interpolate between slices and save a 3D label TIFF.
records.source: Open a folder of images to curate. The arrow also opens one image file: a 2D image opens with the other images of its folder, a z-stack or volume (TIFF, OME-TIFF or MRC) opens in the Mask view to draw 3D masks slice by slice, interpolate between slices and save a 3D label TIFF.
records.translation: Abre una carpeta de imágenes para curar. La flecha también abre un único archivo de imagen: una imagen 2D se abre con las demás imágenes de su carpeta; una pila z o un volumen (TIFF, OME-TIFF o MRC) se abre en la vista Mask para dibujar máscaras 3D corte a corte, interpolar entre cortes y guardar un TIFF de etiquetas 3D.
